subject: Open Capital: Exploring a partnership for ThriveAgric
body:
Hi there,

I came across ThriveAgric and believe there may be a strong fit between your work and Open Capital’s advisory and market-building capabilities in Africa.

Open Capital focuses on growth, investment enablement, and market building across sectors including agriculture, food systems, clean energy, and development-oriented businesses. ThriveAgric is an agri-business platform and rural growth company in Africa, which matches Open Capital’s focus on agricultural value chains, market building, and client-support programs.

I would welcome a conversation about how Open Capital could support ThriveAgric in areas such as strategy, market access, investment readiness, and growth enablement.

If this is of interest, I’d be happy to set up a brief call to explore fit and next steps.

Best,
[Your Name]
